paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: : Search space of the dataset under different configurations.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the number of possible solutions in relation to the number of missing pieces within the M-Cube dataset. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 1 to 6, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1, and the scale is logarithmic, starting at 10^0 and extending to 10^8. The y-axis is also logarithmic, starting at 10^0 and extending to 10^8. A line in orange with circular markers represents “Flip needed,” beginning at a data point of approximately 10^3 and increasing to approximately 10^7. A line in blue with circular markers represents “Flip ignored,” beginning at a data point of approximately 8 x 10^3 and increasing to approximately 5 x 10^6. Finally, a line in cyan with circular markers represents “Flip ignored,” beginning at a data point of approximately 3 x 10^5 and increasing to approximately 3 x 10^6.
